fix: but were disputing over Sardinia and Sicily as well [...] and were trying to grasp everything
reason: Greek marks an omission after ἠμφισβήτουν; mark with project convention [...] rather than descriptive bracket text.

fix: seeing the defenders within beat off his assaults, to his own loss and mockery
reason: τοὺς ἔνδον are the defenders; Marcus is outside. Loss and mockery fall on Marcus; wording kept close to original.

fix: Archimedes was using his ships as ladles to dip water out of the sea
reason: ταῖς ναυσὶν κυαθίζειν ἐκ θαλάττης: the ships are the ladles, dipping from the sea; English inverted the image.

fix: [...] Demetrius, after rashly and recklessly attempting
reason: Excerpt opens mid-sentence; mark gap with [...]. Name is securely recoverable from editor's note and Polyb. 3.19.11.

fix: whereas no one already occupied with a royal court, given the opportunity, would have hesitated to make a timely change to the name and dignity of Greece.
reason: οὐδεὶς ἂν ἐπέσχε: strong negation, not 'might perhaps'; 'greater, more illustrious' absent. Note: 'voluntarily' earlier renders ἀκεραίῳ γνώμῃ (sound judgment) loosely.
Cambylus serves the besieger Antiochus; the ground behind the citadel did not admit siege-works, hence a continuous guard. English is right.

fix: Partly overjoyed, he promised everything; partly distrustful, he examined in detail the several plans and preparations.
reason: τὰ μὲν … τὰ δὲ gives simultaneous mixed reactions; the sequence begins only with μετὰ δὲ ταῦτα.

fix: afterward to make his move toward Syria without any advance notice
reason: δίχα προόδου is obscure; 'circuitous route' is unsupported. Context (ἄφνω, παραδόξως) favors suddenness; translator should confirm reading.

fix: brought him before Antiochus, the two of them alone
reason: ᾗ … νυκτί is time (already rendered 'on the very night'), not route; μόνος πρὸς μόνον: private audience.

fix: some joining Aribazus and others Laodice
reason: Greek Ἀρίβαζον; matches the Book 7 spelling Aribazus for the same commandant of Sardis.
